title: CLI commands
description:
Step 3 of the build order. Scriptable `underdraw` commands for the user (e.g. `underdraw list`, `underdraw add`, `underdraw next`), going through the daemon's Connect API as the user. Any command auto-starts the daemon if it isn't running.

The CLI replaces `buf curl` for user-only actions while dogfooding: promoting drafts, marking work done, reranking, deleting.

Requirements.md: Interfaces → CLI; Architecture → Daemon (auto-start). A full-screen TUI is later and out of scope here.
